snippet.title: Crimson Colosseum - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Captured by a group of kidnappers on her way back home, the swordswoman Sachi is brought to a mysterious colosseum to serve as its latest slave fighter. To escape from her predicament, she must defeat 7 other fighters to earn her freedom...
